name: ab-registrar
description: The registrar — the house's coordinator and record-keeper (front of house as its own install unit). Owns everything before a ticket hangs and after it files: intake and context curation (steward), the menu registry (who can do what — scan-on-demand over published menus), and the open-orders report (what's queued, leased, parked, aging on the rail). Never cooks: no expo, no stations, no service verb, no rail lock — the first 'house role' brigade kind (BRIGADE-INTERFACE.md). Vendors the canon rail adapter + the five specs it binds to (stamped, sha256-verified) so it installs wherever the rail and cellar are reachable, factory present or not.
